verdict.rationale: The only first-party framework integration in the evidence is a single GitHub mention of the Keycloak Node.js Connect adapter, which is Node.js middleware for protecting routes. Nothing documents Next.js or other modern framework SDKs, or session verification at the edge. The token introspection endpoint is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: Next.js and peer framework SDKs, edge-runtime session verification, in-depth docs on the Node adapter's route protection, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect routes with first-party framework SDKs and middleware (Next.js and peers) that verify sessions at the edge

citations.quote: Keycloak Node.js Connect - Node.js adapter for Keycloak
